key.text: An engraved acrylic sign with my club's name for our tabling booth, about 12 inches wide. We need one.
retry: routes.0.steps: Too small: expected array to have >=3 items

output.summary: An engraved acrylic sign for a club tabling booth.

needs.why: To cut and engrave the acrylic sheet.

routes.process: Engrave and cut the sign using a laser cutter.
routes.fit_reason: The laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely) handles acrylic engraving easily.

steps.title: Design the sign
steps.detail: Draw the club name in a vector design program.

steps.title: Laser engrave
steps.detail: Use the laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely) to engrave the acrylic sheet.

steps.title: Laser cut
steps.detail: Cut the outer shape of the sign out of the acrylic sheet.

warnings.issue: Laser cutting creates fumes from the plastic.
warnings.fix: Wait for the laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely) to finish and clear before opening.
